about.title2: We built clarity for better decisions.
about.intro: ScorpionFlow was born from a real need: understanding what's happening in a project, beyond tasks and statuses.

timeline.title: We used tools that organized work well.
timeline.body: Tasks, schedules, tracking. But something was missing: the real impact of each project on the business. We had information, not a complete view.

timeline.title: Managing isn't the same as understanding.
timeline.body: Having data doesn't mean having clarity. Many decisions are made without seeing the full picture. That lack of visibility creates errors, delays and losses that could have been avoided.

timeline.title: We decided to build something different.
timeline.body: Not yet another task manager. A platform that lets you understand what's happening, spot risks on time and make decisions with clear information.

timeline.title: Work, projects and business in one place.
timeline.body: Today ScorpionFlow connects tasks, projects and key business information with one clear goal: give context to every decision.

timeline.title: Help every team understand the reality of their projects.
timeline.body: Empower people and teams to decide with clarity, based on information that actually reflects what's going on.

timeline.title: Redefine how projects are managed.
timeline.body: Integrate work and business in a system where every decision makes sense, backed by clear and timely data.
